OPTIONS TRADERS ACADEMY OS — VOICE-OVER RECORDING SHEET
Total runtime 74.00s · 18 cues · 160 words
Read each line inside its own window. Leave the gaps silent — the score
and the picture already fill them. Target pace ~175 wpm, warm and certain,
not hyped. Mix: node render.mjs --vo <your-take.wav>
